memoryReport.scope: Fresh-process peak RSS from the actual timed binaries; no timing samples from GNU time or instrumented binaries. Separate fwp profiles count managed requests/bytes, retains and charged live storage after constant initialization through language cleanup. Counts exclude runtime raw buffers, allocator metadata, stacks and C/Rust allocations. Stack reports describe instrumented binaries, not the original timed executables.
